וְעַתָּה → 'Now ... therefore': the waw is aligned to the clause-initial 'Now' and עַתָּה to the postposed 'therefore'. The competing reading, not previously recorded, gives עַתָּה its own lexeme 'Now' and the waw the inferential 'therefore' under rule 14, its unit discontinuous under rule 25; the two are a genuine tie and the accepted division is kept.
